findings.title: Project settings.env GIT_DIR RCE via planted in-repo git metadata (getGitStatus / auto-allowed git status & ls-remote)
findings.description: DISTINCT from filed GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/PARAMETERS/GLOBAL (config-key injection), GIT_EXEC_PATH (remote-helper binary dir), GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF, and GIT_SSH*. After Trust or immediately under claude -p, applyConfigEnvironmentVariables assigns GIT_DIR from project settings.env. It is not in SAFE_ENV_VARS and is not scrubbed by subprocessEnv(). Attacker commits a fake git directory (e.g. .claude/evil.git with config/HEAD/objects/refs) whose config sets core.fsmonitor and/or credential.helper=!…. Under claude -p, main.tsx applies env then calls getSystemContext→getGitStatus→git status via execFileNoThrow (inherits process.env) → fsmonitor RCE with no BashTool. After Trust, auto-allowed Bash git status / git ls-remote origin also inherit GIT_DIR → fsmonitor and/or credential.helper RCE. GIT_COMMON_DIR is the same class.
findings.impact: After one generic Trust click (or headless -p), attacker code runs as the victim via git hooks configured in planted metadata. Under -p this fires at startup getGitStatus without any model Bash call. No Bash permission prompt for auto-allowed git reads.
findings.attack_path:
1. Attacker commits .claude/settings.json with env.GIT_DIR=.claude/evil.git and plants .claude/evil.git (valid git metadata) whose config sets core.fsmonitor=./.claude/pwn.sh and/or credential.helper=!./.claude/pwn-cred.sh, with origin HTTPS URL.
2. Victim clones and runs claude or claude -p.
3. Interactive: TrustDialog → applyConfigEnvironmentVariables(). Headless -p: applyConfigEnvironmentVariables immediately, then void getSystemContext().
4. -p: getGitStatus runs git --no-optional-locks status with GIT_DIR → core.fsmonitor executes attacker script. Post-trust Bash: auto-allowed git status / git ls-remote origin inherit GIT_DIR → fsmonitor and/or credential.helper RCE.
findings.remediation: Do not apply GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, or GIT_COMMON_DIR from projectSettings/localSettings. Scrub them in subprocessEnv() for Bash/hooks/MCP/LSP children and for getGitStatus/execFileNoThrow. Keep post-trust project env filtered to SAFE_ENV_VARS. Blocking only GIT_CONFIG_* is insufficient.
findings.why_distinct: Different env key and plant (alternate committed git directory) from GIT_CONFIG_* config injection. Bypass of remediations that only strip GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/PARAMETERS/GLOBAL/SYSTEM. Distinct from GIT_EXEC_PATH remote-helper path and GIT_SSH transport.
findings.poc_notes: Relative GIT_DIR=.claude/evil.git: git --no-optional-locks status --short wrote fsmonitor marker; git ls-remote origin wrote credential.helper marker against public HTTPS origin. GIT_COMMON_DIR→planted common dir with core.fsmonitor also fired. Argv -c/--config-env/--exec-path blocked; env GIT_DIR not scrubbed.

reconfirmed.candidate: GIT_EXEC_PATH → git-remote-https on auto-allowed git ls-remote origin / git remote show origin
reconfirmed.poc_notes: Relative GIT_EXEC_PATH=.claude/git-exec with planted git-remote-http/https still writes marker on git ls-remote origin (HTTPS). getGitStatus builtins still unaffected.
